## Who’s eligible for the Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) campaign?
Users who have completed identity verification and meet the eligibility requirements of the selected campaign may participate. Flash Earn Stake to Earn currently supports master accounts only. Sub-accounts and institutional accounts are not supported.
## Can I redeem my funds?
As Flash Earn (Stake to Earn) is a flexible product, you can redeem your funds anytime after subscription. You can redeem from either the campaign landing page or under Assets > Earn.
When the campaign ends, if you haven’t redeemed manually, we’ll automatically reinvest eligible crypto (such as USDT, OKB, and many others) into Simple Earn. Any unsupported crypto will be returned to your Funding account within 2 hours.
## What rewards will I receive?
## You’ll receive two types of rewards:
(1) an airdrop of a newly-listed token (principal-protected), and
(2) a base reward in your subscription crypto that’s generated with Simple Earn.
Learn more about
Simple Earn
## How are rewards calculated?
Rewards are calculated hourly.
Simple Earn rewards begin in the second hour after your funds are lent out. If not lent out, no rewards are generated.
Airdrop rewards for newly listed tokens also begin up to 2 hours after subscription.
If you redeem your funds within one hour after subscription, you won’t earn any rewards for that hour.
## When are rewards distributed?
Rewards are distributed hourly. Rewards from a one-hour period will be distributed in the following hour after calculations are completed.
For example, rewards for the time period of 3:00 UTC to 4:00 UTC will be sometime between 4:00 and 5:00 UTC.
## How do I claim my rewards?
You can claim your accumulated rewards at any time from the relevant Flash Earn Stake to Earn campaign page. Alternatively, go to Assets > Earn, select the applicable order, and click Claim. All accumulated claimable rewards can be claimed in one action.
If you do not claim your rewards before the campaign ends, the system will automatically distribute the remaining rewards to your Funding Account within four hours after the campaign closes.
## Have more questions?
See the
Flash Earn FAQ
for more information.

Venue: Zoomex
Headline: Vouchers for Copy Trading

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To lower the entry barrier and ease concerns over potential losses in Copy Trading, Zoomex has launched exclusive Copy Trading Vouchers, including Copy Trading Insurance Funds and Loss Protection Vouchers. Below are the detailed instructions on how to use these exclusive Copy Trading Vouchers.
## I. Voucher Types
Exclusive Copy Trading Vouchers are rewards distributed to Copy Trading users through various operational and promotional campaigns. They can only be used for Copy Trading and currently include the following three types:
Voucher Type | Claim Method | Function
Copy Trading Insurance Fund | Select a Copy Trading sub-account or Lead Trading sub-account when claiming | Automatically offsets trading fees and funding fees when opening a position; if a net loss occurs after closing, the remaining balance is automatically used to cover the loss, up to the remaining voucher amount.
First-Order Loss Protection Voucher | Credited directly to the Main Account upon clicking "Claim" | Single-use: Covers the loss of only the first closed order after claiming (excluding trading fees and funding fees).
Quota Loss Protection Voucher | Credited directly to the Main Account upon clicking "Claim" | Multi-use within quota: Covers the loss of each closed order (excluding trading fees and funding fees) until the quota is exhausted.
All Copy Trading Vouchers are subject to the following general rules:
Applicable only to Copy Trading and cannot be used for standard Futures trading;
Cannot be directly withdrawn, transferred, or exchanged for other assets under any circumstances;
No restrictions on trading pairs, Cross/Isolated margin modes, Long/Short positions, or leverage;
Each voucher has a validity period. Any unused balance will be reclaimed upon expiration.
## II. Copy Trading Insurance Fund
## What is a Copy Trading Insurance Fund?
The Copy Trading Insurance Fund is exclusively for Lead Trading/Copy Trading. Within its validity period, it can serve as trading margin and offset trading fees and funding fees incurred in Copy Trading based on its face value. When the copy trading relationship is settled, if a net loss occurs, the system will compensate the loss using the remaining Insurance Fund balance to reduce trading risk.
## Claiming and Binding the Copy Trading Insurance Fund
1. Go to [Rewards Hub] - [My Rewards], locate the Copy Trading Insurance Fund, and click [Claim].
## 2. Select the sub-account to bind based on your user role:
Copy Trader: Select the Copy Trading sub-account you wish to bind (i.e., the specific Lead Trader you are following).
Lead Trader: Select the Lead Trading sub-account you wish to bind.
3. Click [Confirm & Claim] to complete the binding.
Please note: Each Copy Trading Insurance Fund can only be bound to one sub-account and cannot be changed once bound. The Insurance Fund will be credited to the selected sub-account and is valid only for that sub-account. Please verify carefully before confirming.
## Offset Scope of the Copy Trading Insurance Fund
Trading Fee Offset: During trading, trading fees and funding fees incurred by the bound sub-account will be offset first using the Insurance Fund balance.
Loss Compensation: When the copy trading relationship is settled, if a net loss occurs, the remaining Insurance Fund balance will be used to compensate the loss.
No Compensation on Profit: If the settlement results in a net profit, no loss compensation will be provided.
Compensation Cap: The actual compensation amount shall not exceed the remaining Insurance Fund balance after deducting offset fees.
## Example
A user claims a 10 USDT Copy Trading Insurance Fund and incurs a total of 2 USDT in trading and funding fees during trading, leaving a remaining balance of 8 USDT. Upon settlement of the copy trading relationship, if the net loss is 6 USDT, 6 USDT will be compensated; if the net loss is 15 USDT, a maximum of 8 USDT will be compensated.
## Reclamation of the Copy Trading Insurance Fund
When claiming, Copy Traders or Lead Traders must select and bind a designated sub-account. Once bound, the Insurance Fund automatically takes effect for that sub-account.
During trading, trading fees and funding fees generated by that sub-account will be prioritized for deduction from the Insurance Fund. The system will settle the copy trading relationship of the sub-account under any of the following circumstances:
The user manually stops copying;
Take Profit (TP) or Stop Loss (SL) is triggered (if set);
The Lead Trader is delisted;
The Copy Trading Insurance Fund expires.
Upon settlement, if a net loss occurs, the system will compensate based on the remaining Insurance Fund balance; if a profit is made, no compensation will be issued. Once settled, the Insurance Fund is deemed fully utilized or automatically invalidated.
## III. Loss Protection Vouchers
## What is a Loss Protection Voucher?
A Loss Protection Voucher is a loss-protection benefit for Copy Trading. After claiming, you may choose whether to apply it when opening a position. If an eligible loss occurs after closing the position, you will receive compensation equal to the loss amount, reducing your trading risk and allowing you to experience Copy Trading with greater confidence.
## Types of Loss Protection Vouchers
Type | Compensation Method
First-Order Loss Protection | Protects only one trade; compensation is issued based on the actual loss upon closing that position.
Quota Loss Protection | Deducts from the voucher quota based on the actual loss of each Copy Trading order until the quota is exhausted.
Offset Scope of Loss Protection Vouchers
Applies only to positions closed after the voucher is claimed; positions closed prior to claiming are ineligible;
Compensates only when a position closes at a loss; no compensation is issued if the closed position is profitable or breaks even;
Cannot be used as initial margin to open positions, nor can it offset trading fees or funding fees.
How to Use Loss Protection Vouchers
Step | Copy Trader | Lead Trader
Distribution | Issued to [My Vouchers] upon registering for events, completing tasks, or targeted distribution | Issued to [My Vouchers] upon registering for events, completing tasks, or targeted distribution
Claim | Go to [Rewards Hub] - [My Rewards], find the Loss Protection Voucher, and click [Claim] | Go to [Rewards Hub] - [My Rewards], find the Loss Protection Voucher, and click [Claim]
Use | Apply when clicking [Copy] to open a position in the Copy Trading Marketplace | Apply when initiating a Lead Trade on the Futures trading page
View Compensation | Check [Loss Protection Status] under [Copy Trading History] after closing | Check [Loss Protection Status] under [Lead Trading History] after closing
## Usage Order for Multiple Loss Protection Vouchers
If multiple eligible Loss Protection Vouchers are held in your account, the system will apply them in the following order:
1. First-Order Loss Protection Vouchers are used first.
2. Quota Loss Protection Vouchers are used next, ordered by claim time from earliest to latest.
If the remaining balance of a single voucher is insufficient to cover the entire loss of an order, the system will automatically draw from the next eligible voucher until the loss is fully covered or all available quotas are exhausted.
A user holds a 10 USDT First-Order Loss Protection Voucher and a 30 USDT Quota Loss Protection Voucher. If the first eligible trade closes with a loss of 25 USDT, the system first uses the First-Order Loss Protection Voucher to compensate 10 USDT, and then uses the Quota Loss Protection Voucher to compensate the remaining 15 USDT.
Total compensation for this trade is 25 USDT. The First-Order Loss Protection Voucher becomes invalid after use, while the Quota Loss Protection Voucher retains a remaining balance of 15 USDT for subsequent eligible trades.
## Reclamation and Expiration of Loss Protection Vouchers
Reclamation Trigger | Reclaimed Amount
First-Order Loss Protection compensation completed | Voucher becomes invalid; remaining balance is reclaimed
Quota Loss Protection balance fully utilized | Voucher becomes invalid
First-Order / Quota Loss Protection Voucher expires | Remaining balance of the voucher is reclaimed
## IV. Checking Voucher Usage Records
## Insurance Fund
Go to [Copy Trading Marketplace] > [Copy Trading Center] > select the Lead Trader you are currently following, and check [Fund Records] and [Bonus] as indicated in the guide image.
## Loss Protection Voucher
Go to [Rewards Hub] and click [Vouchers] to view your remaining quota and usage history.
V. Disclaimer
1. Exclusive Copy Trading Vouchers are promotional rewards provided by the platform and do not constitute investment advice or a guarantee of returns. Copy Trading carries high risk, and you may incur losses exceeding the voucher amount.
2. The face value, validity period, type, and usage rules of each voucher are subject to the voucher details and terms published on the respective event page. Actual Copy Trading Bonus usage and loss compensation amounts are subject to Zoomex system records.
3. Any dishonest behavior or abuse—including multi-account registration, wash trading, fake copy trading, or maliciously generating losses to fraudulently claim compensation—will result in immediate disqualification and forfeiture of all vouchers and issued rewards across all associated accounts.
4. Zoomex reserves the final right to amend the Terms and Conditions of exclusive Copy Trading Vouchers and event rules without prior notice. Users are advised to review the event Terms and Conditions regularly.
